verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents webhook subscriptions for wallet events (transfers, signer exports), payment/order lifecycle events, and auth-related user events, giving real-time event subscription for several core resources. However, the most agent-specific feature — Agent Checkouts — explicitly states 'no webhooks in v1', requiring polling instead, so agentic workflow status updates are not uniformly webhook-driven. missing for 10: webhook support for agent checkout lifecycle (currently poll-only), independent/third-party confirmation of webhook reliability.
